rationale: The workflow already carries the applicable evidence-supported optimizations for its shape. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching via actions/cache) is already present, so re-adding a cache is barred by the "equivalent cache already exists" contraindication. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is already present via timeout-minutes: 60 (below the 360-minute default), and there is no representative successful-duration history to retune it—the CI history shows only consecutive schedule failures—so that pattern's precondition is unmet. The remaining patterns do not fit: no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no Bazel (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), a single job (P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST / P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT), test selection would trim required e2e perf coverage (P-LIT-SELECT), and schedule pause/idle suppression are ci_service changes requiring an approved pause/resume policy plus new network/privileged access, which is disallowed. Change filtering risks the required e2e coverage. No supported workflow_yaml change preserves coverage and satisfies preconditions.
